banking-money-supply-balance-sheet.alt: A T-account for an invented bank with a required reserve ratio of 0.1. Assets: reserves of 300 dollars, of which 100 dollars are required and 200 dollars are excess, and loans of 700 dollars. Liabilities: checkable deposits of 1,000 dollars. Below: required reserves are 1,000 times 0.1, or 100 dollars; excess reserves are 300 minus 100, or 200 dollars; the bank can lend at most 200 dollars; the money supply can grow by at most 200 times 10, or 2,000 dollars.
